source: segmentation (Blender simulation with background replaced by white)

camera.evidence: phase correlation of building region (y 0-600, x 450-1300) vs frame 0: |dx|,|dy| <= 0.18 px in all frames; see tracks/background_shift.csv
camera.view: the bird is seen from directly above/below (plan view of the spread wings); its motion is a plane facing the camera, no visible perspective change on the bird (body length constant ~129 px)

objects.name: bird
objects.description: single large dark grey/black bird of prey (hawk/eagle/crow-like) seen in plan view, wings spread and flapping, head pointing +x (right). Only moving object.
objects.reference_point_recommended: cx_centroid, cy_centroid (mask centroid). Alternatives: body_mid_x/body_y (midpoint of the beak tip and tail tip on the body row, steadier against wing flapping); bbox_cx/bbox_cy
objects.motion_summary_px: flies left to right (+x) almost horizontally; body_mid_x 749 -> 1718 px, body_y 1108 -> 1112 px. Per-frame step about 7 px at the start, rising to about 20 px by frame ~13, roughly constant about 20 px for frames 13-45, then slowing to about 6 px at frame 60

sizes_px.wingspan_axis: image y (vertical) = wingspan_px_y column; varies with flapping

objects.name: wooden_building
objects.description: static remnant of the original background not removed by segmentation: weathered vertical wooden planks (wall/shed seen from above or the front) with a slanted plank/beam ledge at its bottom edge, top of image

image_extent_px.note: cut off at top edge; includes debris below

parts_px.plank_wall: x about 420-1340, y 0 to about 620 (cut at top)
parts_px.bottom_beam_ledge: long slanted plank from about (400,675) to (1385,650), about 985 px long
parts_px.small_cross_beam: short light beam at about x 655-860, y 450-530
parts_px.dark_box_under_ledge: dark wooden box/crate at about x 590-930, y 600-700

objects.name: debris_patch
objects.description: small static grey fragment below the building at about x 830-980, y 735-792 (segmentation leftover); its size flickers frame to frame (larger mask in frames 0, 7, 8, 10, 20, 33). Not a real moving object.
